channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Curated tech opinion picks, supplement to the daily chat digest. Excludes sources already subscribed in NetNewsWire (Daring Fireball, Hacker News, Simon Willison's Weblog, Sinocism, Stratechery).

item.title: Bruce Schneier: The Future of AI Cryptanalysis
item.description: Schneier pushes back on Matthew Green's bleak series about AI outperforming humans in cryptanalysis — he's more optimistic, betting on cryptographers' habit of over-engineering their ciphers.
